rulings.challenge_claim: The rejected_alternative's claim that "the same vocative frame govern[s]" all seven verses from 31:2 to 31:8 ("7 of 7") overstates the grammatical uniformity of the unit.
rulings.grounds: Re-derived person/number for every finite verb and address term in oshb:Prov.31.2-Prov.31.9 directly from the pointed bytes (tier-1). oshb:Prov.31.3 תִּתֵּ֣ן is unambiguous 2ms (Qal imperfect-as-prohibition; the yod-vs-tav preformative rules out any 3ms reading), addressed to Lemuel with the 2ms suffix on the same verse's object. oshb:Prov.31.5 יִ֭שְׁתֶּה/וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח/וִֽ֝ישַׁנֶּה all carry the yod preformative, unambiguous 3ms imperfect (a 2ms reading would require the tav preformative) -- these describe a third party ("lest HE drink and forget... and pervert..."), not direct address to Lemuel. oshb:Prov.31.6 תְּנוּ is the 2mp imperative (its plural suffix distinguishes it from the shorter 2ms imperative form of the same root used elsewhere in the book), addressed to a different party/number than the 2ms frame. oshb:Prov.31.7 יִ֭שְׁתֶּה/וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח (yod preformative) and יִזְכָּר (Niphal, yod preformative) are again unambiguous 3ms, continuing the third-party description begun in 31:5. oshb:Prov.31.8 פְּתַח and oshb:Prov.31.9 פְּתַח both return to the bare 2ms imperative. This confirms LF's claim exactly: of the seven verses 31:2-31:8, three (31:5, 31:6, 31:7) do not carry the 2ms address the rejected_alternative calls a uniform "vocative frame" governing "7 of 7" -- 31:5 and 31:7 are 3ms narrative about an unnamed king-figure, 31:6 is 2mp imperative to a different addressee. The owner-ratified single royal_instruction unit for 31:1-9 is untouched by this: the petuchah bracket at oshb:Prov.30.33/oshb:Prov.31.9 and the envelope structure (mother's address opened at 31:2, resumed in 2ms imperative at 31:8-9) remain sufficient boundary warrant on their own, without the overstated grammatical-uniformity claim.
rulings.remedy: Rewrite the rejected_alternative sentence: replace "with the same vocative frame governing both" / the "7 of 7" figure with the accurate object and count -- of the seven verses 31:2-31:8, four (31:2 vocative address; 31:3 2ms prohibition; 31:4 vocative לְֽמוֹאֵ֗ל plus infinitive; 31:8 2ms imperative) carry the mother's direct singular address, while three (31:5, 31:7: 3ms narrative describing an unnamed king-figure; 31:6: 2mp imperative to a different addressee) depart from it within the same wine-warning topic -- and ground the single-unit rebuttal on the petuchah bracket and address-envelope structure instead. Test the cure must pass: re-collate the finite-verb/vocative person and number for every verse 31:2-31:9 against oshb pointed bytes (the yod-vs-tav imperfect preformative test and the imperative singular/plural suffix test used here) and confirm the corrected digit and object survive.
